'''Chapter 1110''' is titled "Starfall". 

==Cover Page==
[[Oni Child Yamato's Golden Harvest Surrogate Pilgrimage]] Vol. 2 "I want to travel throughout [[Wano Country|Wano]]!! Like [[Kouzuki Oden|Oden]] did!!"

==Short Summary==
While there is seven minutes left before the broadcast begins, the other members of the [[Five Elders]] have arrived at [[Egghead]] and have all utilized their [[Zoan]] abilities. Beginning their attack, [[Ethanbaron V. Nusjuro|Nusjuro]] disables the [[Pacifista]]s, allowing the [[Marines]] to focus on eliminating [[Jewelry Bonney|Bonney]]. Meanwhile after being contacted through a [[Den Den Mushi]] with an update, [[Jinbe]], locates [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] and [[Rob Lucci|Lucci]], where after hearing [[Sanji]]'s insult, Zoro quickly attacks Lucci. Meanwhile, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] is devoured by [[Shepherd Ju Peter|Ju Peter]], but is saved by [[Dorry]] and [[Brogy]].

==Long Summary==
The [[Five Elders]]' arrival is noticed by everyone on the island as the battle rages on. In the video, [[Vegapunk|Dr. Vegapunk]] finishes preparing coffee using one of his new inventions, though it only took about three minutes, so there are seven minutes left until the broadcast officially begins. Dr. Vegapunk even says that if anyone tried to silence his broadcast, that amount of extra time will not be enough to stop it.

The Elders appear before [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] as their names and forms are revealed: [[Jaygarcia Saturn]] is a ''gyūki''; [[Marcus Mars]], an ''itsumade''; [[Topman Warcury]], a ''fengxi''; [[Ethanbaron V. Nusjuro]], a ''bakotsu''; and [[Shepherd Ju Peter]], a ''sandworm''.

Immediately, Nusjuro sees the [[Pacifista]] attacking the [[Marines]] and changes into his hybrid form, where he gallops at breakneck speed, slashing the cyborgs. Because he moved so fast, the Marines under attack did not see him at all, though reports of a large horse running around and taking down the Pacifista were all over the Marines' radios. To the Marines' surprise, the Pacifista have not been cut, but partially frozen, thereby rendering them immobile. Soon, half of the Pacifista are incapacitated, which the Marines celebrate over because now they can resume their hunt for [[Jewelry Bonney|Bonney]].

Mars takes to the sky and starts attacking the Frontier Dome while [[Sanji]] tries desperately to get in contact with his crew so he can tell them to escape ASAP. Once he does so, [[Usopp]] informs him that they understand they need to escape, but [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] is still fighting [[Rob Lucci|Lucci]]. Thankfully, they have reunited with [[Brook]] and [[Vegapunk/Lilith|Lilith]] on board the [[Thousand Sunny]], which Usopp stopped using '''Midori Boshi: Take Jave Rin'''. Meanwhile, Saturn, Warcury, and Ju Peter start fighting Luffy, with Ju Peter diving under the ground. [[Jinbe]] is still trying to reach Zoro and says he will drag him back by force if necessary.

Speaking of, Zoro gets one of his swords knocked out of his hand by Lucci, who tries to tempt him to abandon the fight by investigating the powerful [[Haki]] that popped up when the Five Elders arrived. Jinbe finally reaches Zoro's location where he tells Sanji that he is still fighting. This prompts Sanji to call Zoro a burden for taking his time fighting, and when Zoro overhears Sanji's words, he decides to finish the fight using a move called [[Three Sword Style#After the Timeskip|'''Three Sword Style''''':'' '''Kokoba Madara Gari''']], finally taking down Lucci.

As for Luffy, Ju Peter appears from underneath him and swallows him whole. However, [[Dorry]] and [[Brogy]] finally arrive on the scene and decapitate Ju Peter, freeing Luffy. Luffy is surprised to see the giants again as they tell him they got tired of waiting for him to show up in [[Elbaph]], so they decided to come pick him up instead.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*There are 7 minutes left until the start of [[Vegapunk]]'s broadcast.
*The [[Five Elders]] are now fully gathered at [[Egghead]] and undergo their [[Zoan]] [[Devil Fruit]] transformations.
**[[Jaygarcia Saturn]] is a ''gyuki'', an ox-spider hybrid yōkai.
**[[Marcus Mars]] is an ''itsumade'', a reptilian bird yōkai.
**[[Topman Warcury]] is a ''fengxi'', a four-tusked boar demon.
**[[Ethanbaron V. Nusjuro]] is a ''bakotsu'', a skeletal horse yōkai.
**[[Shepherd Ju Peter]] is a ''sandworm'', a gigantic desert worm.
*Nusjuro immobilizes most of the rogue [[Pacifista#Mark III|Pacifista]] units.
**Nusjuro is confirmed to possess [[Haki/Armament Haki|Armament Haki]].
*Vice-Admiral [[Doberman]] orders the [[Marines]] to prioritize [[Jewelry Bonney]] as their target.
*Mars flies towards the Labophase and hits the Frontier Dome.
**[[Sanji]] alerts the other [[Straw Hat Pirates]] to immediately flee the Labophase.
**[[Usopp]] was able to stop the [[Thousand Sunny]] from sliding off the edge with one of his [[Pop Green]]s, allowing [[Brook]] and [[Vegapunk/Lilith|Lilith]] to rejoin his group.
*[[Roronoa Zoro]] attacks [[Rob Lucci]], concluding their fight.
*[[Dorry]] and [[Brogy]] rescue [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] by decapitating Ju Peter's beast form.

==Trivia==
*The full double page spread of the [[Five Elders]] is the first full page double spread since [[Chapter 800]], which came out almost nine years before Chapter 1110.
*Dorry and Brogy saving Luffy from being eaten by St. Shephard Ju Peter is similar to when Dorry saved Luffy from being eaten by [[Brontosaurus]] in [[Chapter 116]].
